name: Szarvas (Hungary)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a white hoist half and a blue fly half, charged at the centre with the town arms of Szarvas: a blue shield with a yellow stag on a green mound within a yellow baroque frame.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szarvas arms in a yellow frame
